
The default controls for ''[[Red Dead Redemption]]'' are listed below. In cases where the consoles use different terminology, the Xbox 360 control is listed first followed by the equivalent PlayStation 3/PlayStation 4 control, and Nintendo Switch control.

== Controls ==

=== On foot ===
* Left Analog: Movement
** Press (L3) to crouch
* Right Analog: Camera control
** Press (R3) to look behind the character
** Press (R3) while aiming to trigger [[Dead-Eye Targeting]])
* Directional buttons
** Up: Whistle for [[Horses|horse]]
** Left, Right: Switch aim between right, left shoulders
** Down: Zoom out the mini-map
* Left Bumper/L1/L: Draw/holster weapon or hold to open the Weapon Wheel
* Right Bumper/R1/R: Attach to cover
** In Dead-Eye: mark targets
** While aiming, without gun: block
* Left Trigger/L2/ZL: Aim
* Right Trigger/R2/ZR: Shoot (Punch, if unarmed)
* A/X/B: Run (Tap repeatedly to gain speed, then hold to stay at that speed)
* Y/Triangle/X: Mount Horse, interact with vehicle
* X/Square/Y: Jump/Climb/Evasive roll or dodge (while targeting and moving left or right)
* B/Circle/A: Reload weapon (if drawn), focus on important event
** Near an NPC: Perform a [[Greeting|greeting]] or [[Taunt|taunt]]
* Select: Open [[Satchel]]
* Start: Pause menu

=== On horseback ===
* Left Analog: Movement
* Right Analog: Camera (press for Dead Eye when aimed)
* Left Bumper/L1:/L Draw Weapon (tap)
* Right Bumper/R1/R: Pull on reins
* Left Trigger/L2/ZL: Aim
* Right Trigger/R2/ZR: Shoot
* A/X/B: Spurs (press for speed boost, hold to maintain fellow rider's pace)
* Y/Triangle/X: Dismount
* X/Square/Y: Hitch horse (near a hitching post only), Jump (if moving fast), Rear up (if moving slow/stopped)

=== Driving Carriage/Wagon/Stagecoach ===
*Left Analog: Steer
*Right Analog: Camera
*R3: Dead Eye
*Left Bumper/L1/L: Weapon Wheel
*Right Bumper/R1/R: Pull on reins
*Left Trigger/L2/ZL: Draw weapon and aim
*Right Trigger/R2/ZR: Shoot
*A/X/B: Whip reins (Repeatedly tap for speed increase, hold to maintain carriage pace)
*Y/Triangle/X: Dismount Carriage

==Trivia==
*If a player were to not use any of the controls for a certain amount of time then the camera will switch to a scenic view of the area that the player is currently in. Using any control will return the player to the normal view.
